notes:
• Translation & AI protocol: every translation, AI summary and AI read is recorded per matter (when, document, provider/model, language, text size, duration, user, outcome) — Tools ▸ Protocol or ⌥⌘L; filter, jump to the document, export CSV, print.
• Printing: File ▸ Print Document List… (⇧⌘P) prints the list as shown as a paginated table; File ▸ Print Document… (⌘P) prints the previewed PDF, image, RTF/text or Word file (others open in their own app).
• Exhibits with an AI-generated summary show a ✦ marker in the list (model and date on hover); the Summary tab labels the text as AI-generated.
